description:
Canada's Finest Shirts for Men

Just White Shirts is a global menswear brand that has been recognized as an industry leader for the last 25 years. Known for our unswerving attention to detail and a quintessential British sensibility, our products have always delivered something more than just the ordinary. Made from the finest fabrics from around the world, along with our commitment to premium tailoring and cutting-edge design technology, we promise you won’t find a finer shirt anywhere else on the planet.


Claim Your Power With Our Printed Shirts

We design more than just shirts. We empower individuals to express themselves by offering them wearable art that inspires confidence and sophistication. We want to help create a world where everybody is able to express their individualistic style and passion without reservation. We want to build a community that celebrates creativity and self expression through our wearable art. Express your authentic self with JWS Printed Shirts!

 

Graphic Shirts That Give You a Personalized Experience

After carving a reputation for ourselves as the producers of the industry leading Ultimate White Shirt, that is stain resistant, non-iron, anti-odor, and wrinkle free, we are introducing a  new line of shirts that are inspired by culture and art.

To develop the designs for this new line of printed shirts, our designers have trekked the globe, seeking out new adventures, new places, and new people. Their aim, to design a shirt that connects different cultures and peoples through the language of textile. Our prints have become a diary of our travels, communicating the essence of far-flung destinations, communities, and culture. The new JWS Printed Shirt is a poetic collision of imagery and personal experiences.

 

Dress for Yourself, not for Others

We believe that clothes are a form of self-expression. We craft shirts for the individual. With our decades of acquired knowledge and expertise of what the modern man wants in his wardrobe, JWS is here to help men express themselves fully. We understand that every man wants to own his personal style, and we are here to make that possible.

 

Stand Out of the Crowd. Be Different. Be You!

While an average person makes about 3500 decisions per day, deciding what to wear is one of the most important out of these decisions that helps define who you are. Whether you want to express your sensitive side by wearing a floral print or show confidence by wearing an eye-catching statement piece, the new link of graphic shirts by JWS have you covered. Wear a JWS Graphic Shirt to feel empowered and more in touch with your inner self.

 

The Perfect Casual Shirt for a Night Out

Unsure about what to wear on a date night? You can never go wrong with our Printed Shirts. They will make you stand out and will be an excellent conversation starter. Also perfect for weekend meetings with friends, movie nights and laid back evenings.

 

Premium Quality

We source only the finest raw materials and our team consists of a network of highly skilled craftspeople and artists who are the finest in their industries. Our shirts are made from 100% Egyptian cotton, designed by designers in Europe and crafted in our 25 year old workshop.

 

Unsurpassed Value

Our shirts are made in our own factory, which means that  we can deliver the highest quality available at only a fraction of the price charged by other luxury brands.

 

Immaculate Design

Great design is at the heart of what we do. We aspire to create beautiful, functional, timeless pieces that are made to last. Every season we develop a curated selection of fabrics from the world’s finest mills, pairing them with elegant design details that rival the most prestigious luxury brands.

Welcome to Just White Shirts! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: info@justwhiteshirts.com.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to info@justwhiteshirts.com for support.
